- Procurement wants to see the SLO addendum and any credit language for missed targets.
- We'd prefer a 2-week onboarding window after signing (engineering/CS handshake).

- Oncall: we'll provide a named business-hours oncall + 24/7 paged escalation for severity 1s.
- Onboarding: proposed 2-week technical onboarding with a kickoff workshop, integration tests, and a validation window. Draft agenda attached.

2) Marissa — I’m looping you to lead the commercial counter and confirm discounting and term language.

Looping in commercial details. Rachel — I can sign off on the structure but recommend the following commercial adjustments to make the renewal economics smoother for Acme and protect Redwood ops: 

- Term: 12 months with an auto-renew opt-out at 60 days. Offer a 5% loyalty credit applied to the first three months of the premium uplift as a gesture.
- Pricing: premium tier adds a 12% uplift to base per-token price; reserved capacity increments priced at negotiated band rates (see attached counter).
- Credit mechanics: cap at 20% of monthly invoice; require customer incident reconciliation within 14 days to qualify.

Ben — on onboarding, can you confirm the staffing plan? I propose: 
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): share runbook + integration checklist (self-serve)
- Week 1: two half-day sessions (systems integration + performance validation) 
- Week 2: staged traffic ramp + final sign-off (Grace to validate SLO test harness)
